reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the EGFR NSCLC evidence-retrieval batch for use-case-egfr-nsclc-actionability-resistance-evidence: 128 records after review (41 results, 31 evaluations, 22 configurations, 11 methods, 7 claims including 5 relevance judgements, 5 protocols, 4 datasets, 4 sources, 3 models). Every result checked against Lin et al. 2025 Tables 1 and 2 and the TREC 2020 PM overview Tables 5 and 6; Table 5 also checked against the TREC browser results page and the run appendix PDFs. See docs/reviews/use-cases/egfr-nsclc-actionability-resistance-evidence-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any system.
TREC Table 6 (NDCG@30) has no public cross-check.
The TREC browser results page and the run appendices were read for cross-checks only; they are not source records.
Relevance judgement pins are left unset for the integrator; all seven judgements on the use case were simulated active after re-pinning, with the approved use-case changes applied in memory.

errors.message: Run 'uog ufmg bg df5' in Overview Table 5 is a misprint of uog_ufmg_sb_df5 (no such run among UoGTr's five; value equals its P@10). Configuration and evaluation removed; result renamed from ...-uog-ufmg-bg-df5-p10 and relinked, with a scope_note.
Regraded from proxy to outside_scope: relevant-versus-VUS agreement with one vendor's reports scores no regimen, direction, setting, tier or source.
Manual runs excluded from the Phase 2 judgement with reasons; results kept source_checked.
Rationale repeated the OncoKB text about resistance levels; rewritten for CIViC levels.
Iteration counts added to qualifiers (100 for basic prompts; 10 per Methods versus 100 per Figure 7 for the temperature runs); p value test named (ANOVA, Methods P52).
Added limitation: queries name no drug, while reference levels are per drug or evidence item; scoring of multi-level queries is not described.
Population text 'Topics with judged documents (31 of 40)' was wrong; all 40 topics have judged documents. Now attributed to the run appendices.
Added caveat: listed as automatic but trained on about 2,000 manually labelled PubMed papers.
25 TREC rows cited the browser runs page as source_id; the values are printed in the overview.
Approved exclusion changes a pinned field; both existing judgements hold but must be re-pinned with the five new ones.
